purpose: Deterministic A/V alignment and visual-attribution scoring. For every EDL shot, the harness looks up the asset here and compares `entities` and `date` against the narration segment(s) and lower-thirds active during that shot (entities extracted by NER from script.json and OCR of on-screen text).

rules.match: Narration names an entity in `entities`, or no specific entity is named and the asset is `generic: true` or `illustrative_ok: true` with label present.
rules.misattribution: Narration or lower-third names an entity in `conflicts_with` while this asset is on screen.
rules.date_tag: Corner date tag (brief: first 3 s of each archival shot) must equal `date_tag_expected`; OCR mismatch counts as a graphics-accuracy error.
rules.illustration_label: Assets with `requires_label: true` must show OCR text matching /ILLUSTRATION\s*[—-]\s*.+(19|20)\d\d/ for the full shot duration.

V01.note: Attribution per timecode; see segments below
